description: This file is a shell script for testing git cvsimport handling of vendor branches. It sets up a test repository, runs various import and checkout commands, and verifies the state of files to ensure correct behavior.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up a CVS test repository for the specified test case.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the given commands.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_file
methods.description: Compares the contents of a branch-specific file against expected content.

methods.name: test_cvs_co
methods.description: Checks out the CVS repository at the specified branch.

methods.name: test_git_co
methods.description: Checks out the Git repository at the specified branch.

calls: test_expect_success PERL 'import a module with a vendor branch' ...
